rule_findings.finding: Living human actor with actor active and phase variables may formally cancel even after identity/authority drift. It does not require full current_trigger.

Only actor captured lists are traversed. Rite cleanup requires matching owner+actor serial; member cleanup requires matching owner+member serial. Unmatched foreign/later stamps are retained. Actor active/phase/authority fields and three lists are removed/cleared; actor serial/nonce, captured faith/main and result receipt fields survive.

No explicit retry count, interval, cooldown or fee assignment in this cancel/begin/nominate/seal flow. New begin remains blocked by active I3b/C2/C3, any current Faith Rite C2/C3/I3b owner, incompatible/non-headless Faith, or actor ineligibility. No successful enactment is implied: an enacted Faith would fail the required headless gate.

Cancel does not increment actor S or N. New begin increments S and N each by1 (initializes only if absent); nominate/accept preserves N; seal advances phase1 to2 and increments N by1. Symbols derive from the actual old checkpoint, not assumed values.

Ordinary nomination/ballot/signature/review callbacks require current full roster/authority plus exact actor saved S,N,phase. Old event scopes are never rewritten inside callbacks. Old cancel popup additionally matches actor S,N,phase; after cancel active/phase absent, after new begin S/N differ. Hidden 439 expiry compares original S and remaining phase, so phase/nonce changes within its own round do not disable expiry, while a newer S prevents closing the new round.

Ordinary 411 NO writes vote0 and leaves the proposal active; it does not add yes or close. New begin resets current captured living member vote=-1, was_elector/was_player capture and player_yes=0; new seal creates 411 for each fresh elector. NPC has source AI weights YES60/NO40 each new valid event. A repeat is allowed; neither different RNG outcome nor eventual YES is guaranteed.
Separate 412 human refusal or 413 representative refusal closes the actor round. Do not equate these with an elector 411 NO.

Dormant is set only when both rite_counties==0 and captured members_total==0. Rite169 with0counties and51living members is active, and2eligible electors require2YES: 3*1-2*2=-1; 3*2-2*2=2. Future counts must be recaptured; county possession is not a prerequisite for elector eligibility.

Cancel/begin/nominate/seal manipulate captured round variables and event delivery, not doctrine/head/title/holder setters. Old enactment result receipt variables survive cleanup; old result431/432 are receipt review, not authorization for a new round.

Existing generic Confirm writes a persistent once claim before one dispatch. An unresolved claim blocks the same semantic Confirm across revisions/reconnects and generic/fixed APIs. A source-legal new proposal does not authorize replay of an unresolved prior API claim; use actual fresh revision and keep all prior claims/verification artifacts.
